title: dortmanna zeylanica
intro: Dortmanna zeylanica, commonly known as Ceylon ironwood or Ceylonese ironwood, is a plant species native to Sri Lanka. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties and is used to treat various health conditions. The health benefits of Dortmanna zeylanica include its anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties, which can help alleviate symptoms of fever, cough, and respiratory issues. The plant's therapeutic actions are attributed to its bioactive constituents, including flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic acids, which work together to provide its medicinal effects.
